description: Find and fix a bug; the corrected function is run against tests.

tests.prompt:
This function should return the last n items of a list, but it returns one item too many. Fix it and return the corrected function in one ```python block.

```python
def last_n(items, n):
    return items[len(items) - n - 1:]
```
tests.reference:
```python
def last_n(items, n):
    return items[len(items) - n:]
```
